title: Missing Proof of Delivery / Signed Receipt
description: Dispatch record exists showing 100 pcs dispatched, but no signed receipt or proof of delivery is present in the provided dataset.

dispute.message: Payment withheld on invoice INV-2026-004. Goods allegedly not received, but supplier dispatch records show dispatch.

expected_findings.statement: No signed receipt or proof of delivery found in the provided dataset for shipment SHP-2026-004.
assumptions: Supplier dispatch record DSPT-REC-004 confirms recorded dispatch of 100 pcs on 2026-10-11.
limitations: Absence of a signed receipt in the provided dataset does not establish whether physical delivery succeeded or failed.
expected_findings.next_step: Obtain signed physical delivery acknowledgment or transporter electronic confirmation.

must_not_claim: The buyer received zero units in reality.
No proof of delivery exists outside the provided dataset.
